title: Remove wsg_grabber from the monorepo after extracting it
objective: wsg_grabber lives only in kuhyx/wsg-grabber (private, ~/src/wsg-grabber); nothing in testsAndMisc still carries or runs it, and main's CI is green.
acceptance_criteria: python_pkg/wsg_grabber/ no longer exists in the tree.
kuhyx/wsg-grabber holds the package's history (14 commits) plus the standalone setup, and its suite passes at 100% branch coverage.
/usr/local/bin/wsg-grabber runs from ~/src/wsg-grabber and `wsg-grabber stats` reads the live index.
AGENTS.md lists wsg-grabber among the extracted repos.
Pre-commit checks and dependency freshness are green on the pushed commit.
out_of_scope: The metadata, duplicate-detection and report features; they are built in the new repo.
Rewriting historical docs that mention the old path.
verifier: ls python_pkg/wsg_grabber fails; git -C ~/src/wsg-grabber log --oneline | wc -l; cat /usr/local/bin/wsg-grabber; wsg-grabber stats; gh run list --branch main
